correctness.rationale: Kendall-tau distance on S5 is inversion count of the position-reordered pair, yielding 120 vertices and exactly 2940 compatibility edges at distance at least six. Independent all-five clique search obtained exactly 168 five-permutation codes and excluded any six-clique. Independently evaluated pairwise distances in every maximum (ten pairs all distance exactly six). Explicit 120 symbol relabelings and position reversal produce 240 distance-preserving maps; their action gives precisely two orbits 48 and 120 and stabilizers 5 and 2. Exactly seven maxima contain identity, of which two close under composition and form cyclic groups of order five; each yields 24 left cosets, the families are disjoint and equal the 48-element orbit. Checked the published Appendix D witness against the orbit classification. This classifies only n=5,d=6 under the specified 240 transformations.

originality.rationale: The full original 2016 Vijayakumaran IEEE paper derives P(5,6)=5 (Table II) and supplies a single maximum five-word code (Appendix D); its conclusion explicitly calls for understanding the algebraic structure of the optimum codes. It does not enumerate all attaining codes, prove every optimum equidistant, give 48/120 orbit decomposition, or classify subgroup maxima. Resultary’s published n=6,d=10 extremizer census has different parameter and cannot imply n=5,d=6 exact counts by restriction without a suitable theorem; none found.
